caretEquivalence: For a line and x, accept only legal (UTF16 endpoint, primary/secondary affinity) pairs whose CTLine caret has exactly the same x within 0.01pt (numerical tolerance). Affinity is the primary/secondary branch; a hit yields an equivalence class, not source correspondence. Every scalar/grapheme interior is excluded even when a ligature spans it; no nearest arbitrary endpoint relaxation.
advancePolicy: CoreText wrapping may include trailing whitespace past the column width. Non-trailing advance must fit width; retain and report full advance separately from ink and column bounds. Legal hit bounds use the actual full line advance, not the ink box.
coordinateSystem: CoreText logical points, document-local first-line baseline origin (0,0), x right, y up; line baselines descend by fontSize*1.6. No backing pixel claims.
